edits.text: Before identifying which orders or items a user wants to modify, return, or cancel, you must call `get_order_details` for every order ID in the list provided by `get_user_details`.
edits.reason: This ensures the agent identifies all relevant orders for modification, return, or cancellation by checking every order returned by the user profile.

edits.text: Load all applicable skills as soon as the categories of the user's requests are identified, even if no database change is imminent.
edits.reason: This ensures the agent has the necessary information and rules available to handle all parts of a multi-part request as soon as it's identified.

edits.text: You must only inform the user that a database change was successful after you have obtained explicit user confirmation and successfully called the relevant tool.
edits.reason: This prevents the agent from claiming a database change was successful before actually executing the tool call or receiving confirmation.

edits.text: When a user's request includes multiple actions, some of which cannot be performed, you must still perform all actions that can be performed before calling `transfer_to_human_agents`.
edits.reason: This ensures the agent fulfills every possible part of a request before transferring the user to a human agent.
